summary: Full re-test after WIV pivot to volunteer-catalogue site. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass (config, countries, projects, courses, registrations, Stripe checkout, PayPal 503). Frontend: all critical flows pass — hero + 9 pills, search 'Sén' → /pays/senegal, Cameroun pill → 3 project cards, project detail with correct mailto (widadinternationalvolunteers@gmail.com) and wa.me/237677958119 hrefs, 2-step registration (empty→toast, underage→toast, unchecked confirm→blocked, valid→advances to payment step), Stripe redirect to checkout.stripe.com verified, PayPal disabled button present, courses flow (/cours → /cours/pays/mali → /cours/detail/mali-bambara-bamako with Programme détaillé + register), footer shows email/WhatsApp/Cameroun/2026/8 country links.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~470 lines and mixes catalog, registrations, Stripe, PayPal, and email. Consider splitting into modules (payments_stripe.py, payments_paypal.py, catalog.py, emails.py) if it grows further.
Stripe amount is correctly server-side from catalog — no client-supplied amount is trusted (good).
server.py hardcodes fallback Stripe key 'sk_test_emergent' when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing; acceptable for sandbox but should log a warning on startup.

Register.jsx line 66 age_max error message references item.age_min instead of both bounds correctly (says 'réservé aux {age_min}-{age_max}') — actually OK, but validate() first checks age_min then age_max so young users always trigger the min-age branch, never the max-age one. Minor UX polish only.
test_credentials: None. Stripe sandbox key already configured. Test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (redirect verified, not completed).
